snippet.title: Cronos: The New Dawn | Launch Trailer
snippet.description:
💥 Play select scenes from the game for free: https://play.ludeo.com/l/bc898c

Experience visceral body horror, unpredictable combat scenarios, tense exploration, strategic resource management and ever-evolving enemies – all within a twisted time-travel story that will have you questioning the very nature of reality! 
 
Such is our calling.

The game will arrive on September 5 to PC, PlayStation 5, Xbox Series X/S and Nintendo Switch 2! Pre-order or Wishlist Cronos: The New Dawn! https://cronosnewdawn.com/

Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2101960/Cronos_The_New_Dawn/
PlayStation: https://store.playstation.com/concept/10011556
Xbox: https://www.microsoft.com/store/productid/9p7tflq7ctxn
Epic Games Store: https://store.epicgames.com/en-US/p/cronos-the-new-dawn-85b409

Music:
"OPERATOR" - Espen Haagensli I Published by: Universal Music Publishing
